question: Where are a museum positioned within 110 kilometers along the south axis of Greenpoint Gallery, Brooklyn, NY?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_DWithin( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Greenpoint Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Brooklyn%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 110000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Greenpoint Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Brooklyn%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
